    max_mass = sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS  # 380 kg

    beam_area = beam_width * beam_height
    density = max_mass / (target_beams * beam_area)

    left_beams = []

        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y, beam_width, beam_height, density=density)
        left_beams.append(beam)
    
    # Create the single required middle beam
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_middle, 3.75, beam_width, beam_height, density=density)
    
    # Create beams in the right strip (max 2 beams)
    right_beams = [
        sandbox.add_beam(x_right, 0.8, beam_width, beam_height, density=density),
        sandbox.add_beam(x_right, 6.2, beam_width, beam_height, density=density)
    ]

        (0.5, 2.5),    # Lower band

        y = beam.position.y

            band_counts[0] += 1
        elif y >= y_bands[1][0] and y < y_bands[1][1]:
            band_counts[1] += 1

    if band_counts[0] < 3:
        for i in range(3 - band_counts[0]):
            beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, 1.3 + i*0.5, beam_width, beam_height, density=density)
            left_beams.append(beam)

    for i in range(len(left_beams) - 1):
